analysis_plan.primary_rule_unchanged: Stage 2 RL rule per task and camera condition (training / held-out / trajectory): seed-mean last-5 success, margin max(0.10, 2 x SE); historical margin verdicts are kept. A difference within the margin is never read as evidence of no effect.
analysis_plan.effect_sizes: per task and condition: difference of seed means (variant - control) for success and return, last-5 / final / AUC (mean over the 100 evaluation points), with 95% percentile-bootstrap CIs (10,000 resamples, fixed RNG seed 0) that resample matched seed IDs jointly across the two arms (paired by RL seed; the unpaired per-arm bootstrap reported alongside); standardised difference (Hedges g over seeds) as a secondary statistic, NA when the pooled SD is 0 (e.g. both arms at the success ceiling); raw differences always reported.
analysis_plan.learning_efficiency: explicit for every comparison (hammer is near the success ceiling): AUC over 1M, early AUC (mean success over the first 30 points, 10k-300k), and time to reach 0.5 and 0.8 training-camera success as the restricted mean through 1M (first evaluation point reaching it; a run that never reaches it counts as 1M) together with the reach rate (runs reaching / runs); differences with the same paired bootstrap CIs.
analysis_plan.aggregates: E1: per-task differences averaged over the eight tasks (and the six non-development tasks), with a task-stratified bootstrap CI (seeds resampled within task and arm); IQM of per-run scores per arm with CI as in the final comparison. E3: the same over eight tasks. E2: dev tasks only, per task.
analysis_plan.representation: E1: the 32 Stage 2 representation metrics of each crop encoder against the full-method encoder of the same task (registered dev-task margins applied as a descriptive yardstick; raw deltas reported). E2: shift vs full and shift vs crop on the same metrics and margins.
analysis_plan.cnn_viewpoint: E3: per task and pooled, report the change in training-camera success alongside the changes in held-out and trajectory success, the novel/training success ratio per run (NA when training success is 0; such runs are counted and listed), and the difference-in-differences (delta novel - delta training, raw success units) with the paired bootstrap CI; a general learning degradation shows as a training-camera drop, a loss of viewpoint robustness as a novel-view drop beyond the training-camera change.
analysis_plan.matched_controls: E1 crop vs full on seeds 2000-2002 for all eight tasks (hammer/pick-place crop at 2000-2002 registered here; their dev-seed 1000-1002 crop results stay a separate, already-reported comparison). E2 shift vs full and vs crop on seeds 1000-1002 only. E3 noshift vs CNN on 2000-2002. Evaluator settings match within each comparison (E1/E2: 3 x 8; E3: as each CNN control).
analysis_plan.decisions: attribution only; the frozen method, its hyperparameters and seeds do not change; non-development task outcomes are never used for method decisions.
